title: Toolbox rail: persistent inline assist and contextual doc link cards for first-week onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, persistent "toolbox rail" that lives at the left edge of the console during a user's first week. The rail exposes contextual inline assistance cards and one-click doc links (snippets, screenshots, example prompts) while minimizing disruption to power users. This ticket covers visual assets, copy variants, proposed interaction states, screenshot frames for release notes, and handoff materials for implementation and QA.
goals: Reduce first-week time-to-value by surfacing 3 recommended quickstarts and 2 example prompts contextual to the route
Provide shallow, non-modal help with clear paths to full docs: preview + ‘Open docs’ CTA
Ship a single set of screenshot assets for console-2025.03 release covering light/dark and compact/dense modes
Ensure accessibility (keyboard navigable, screen-reader labels) and telemetry for feature analytics
acceptance_criteria: Design comps (left-rail collapsed + expanded) delivered as SVG and 2x PNGs for light/dark themes
3 inline card variants (getting started, examples, billing tips) with copy variations and CTA states
Screenshot pack for release: 4 primary frames + 4 annotated overlays for docs and release notes
Interaction spec describing dismiss behavior, persistence (dismiss for 30 days vs re-show on major updates), and deep-link targets
Accessibility checklist passed in design review: focus order, aria labels, 4.5:1 contrast for body copy
Telemetry event list agreed with Eng and PM and noted in handoff doc
assets_requested: Rail collapsed SVG (left, 48x300 canvas) - light and dark
Rail expanded SVG with three stacked cards - 1200px wide artboards - PNG @2x for docs
Inline card components exported as individual SVGs and optimized PNG sprites
4 release screenshot frames (light-expanded, light-collapsed, dark-expanded, dark-collapsed) PNG 1920x1080
Annotated overlays PDF for marketing and release notes
Small animated GIF (640x360) showing rail expand + open doc link
copy_variants: Welcome to Redwood Inference — try a short prompt: "Summarize customer feedback"
Try this sample: "Convert the policy into a checklist" — open labs for examples
Need help? View quickstarts or open the full docs
Tip: Use dedicated models for high-throughput pipelines — learn more
screenshot_specs: Frame A: Light theme, rail expanded, 'Getting started' card visible, highlighted snippet selected
Frame B: Light theme, rail collapsed, hover state showing tooltip icon and keyboard shortcut ("H")
Frame C: Dark theme, rail expanded, billing tip card visible and CTA to billing docs
Frame D: Dark theme, rail expanded on a long list view to show non-intrusive stacking
Annotations: callouts for CTA, close/dismiss, keyboard focus outline, and telemetry toast
accessibility_notes: All interactive elements must be reachable via Tab and have visible focus states
Cards must have role=region with aria-label describing purpose (e.g., 'Toolbox: Getting started')
Expandable rail must announce state changes via aria-expanded and polite live region updates
Contrast: body text >= 4.5:1, small helper text >= 3:1 with large-size compensations
Animations: provide prefers-reduced-motion fallback with instant expand/collapse
